The selected disciple in this counterexample is not shown to minimize the oracle-guided objective. Main Section3.4 explicitly uses a simplified binary loss; the triplet example does not itself refute a realizability-qualified binary finite-sample theorem. It refutes the stated lemma and the supplied triplet derivation that invokes it. Balanced P=L/2 recovers the uniform coefficients.
